reviews.title: This is a fantastic power supply! This is now my favorite PSU!
reviews.comment: This is a fantastic power supply. I love the L Shape design and the integrated USB Fan hub. This Lian Li Edge power supply has nice modular cables. They also give you a 12V 500w cable for the new NVIDIA GeForce RTX 40 and 50 Series graphics cards. This is now my favorite PSU. Lian Li make some great products. This Lian Li Edge1000 PSU is powering my Hyte Y70 Touch case with an Intel i9 CPU, GeForce RTX 5070Ti, and 10 Lian Li SL-INF Uni fans, a Lian Li Galahad AIO, and 2 Hyte Noodles with a NP50. Everything works great! I highly recommend this PSU.
reviews.author: Kevin Cureton

reviews.title: Lian Li Edge is the only power supply I use
reviews.comment: The Platinum series Edge power supplies are by far the best supply for dual and triple chamber cases. They make cable management easy and they perform quietly and dependable.
reviews.author: MetalFan

reviews.title: Lives Up to The Hype
reviews.comment: It's been 5 years since I installed a power supply for my setup. I decided it was time since I dove deeper into the Tier lists of power supplies. My previous one was actually a tier f, which I was shocked. This Lian Li Edge Gold is Tier A, which is basically among the best of the best. Super quiet when it's running, and I shouldn't have to worry about my pc ever starving for power. 10 years of warranty is solid.
reviews.author: TheUnknownGamerTTK

reviews.title: Makes your life easier and makes your PC look better overall.
reviews.comment: This made cable management way easier and the cables themselves actually look decent in the build and not like cheap spindly junk. The only annoying part was getting the extra cable combs on the wires. A++
